## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: -1.72% | 1M: -6.77%) BELOW TREND shows fear easing while HYG (1W: -0.09% | 1M: -0.94%) BELOW TREND vs LQD (1W: +0.36% | 1M: -1.34%) RECOVERY signals rising credit stress — the mix of complacency and credit strain justifies CAUTION.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -1.72% | 1M: -6.77%) BELOW TREND. Credit stress RISING: HYG/LQD tilt (HYG (1W: -0.09% | 1M: -0.94%) BELOW TREND; LQD (1W: +0.36% | 1M: -1.34%) RECOVERY). Reflation tilt: CPER (1W: +2.68% | 1M: +2.13%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-tightening: UUP (Dollar strength proxy) rising (Dollar Level +0.78% 1W) ABOVE TREND while Yield curve (Level 1.0001) ABOVE TREND and TLT (1W: +0.47% | 1M: -1.76%) RECOVERY show mixed duration preference.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Tech leading but narrow: XLK (1W: +1.03% | 1M: +3.25%) ABOVE TREND while Financials (sector: 1W: -2.93% | 1M: -3.80%) BELOW TREND; style: Growth over Value but leadership is narrow (Breadth 2/11).

5. US vs Global?
US mixed: SPY (1W: -0.09% | 1M: -0.71%) BELOW TREND while QQQ (1W: +0.92% | 1M: +0.75%) ABOVE TREND. EM and China lag: EEM (1W: -1.19% | 1M: +1.39%) CORRECTION; FXI (1W: -0.49% | 1M: -3.81%) BELOW TREND.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculation elevated: IBIT (1W: +5.14% | 1M: +18.67%) ABOVE TREND and ARKK (1W: +5.56% | 1M: +5.91%) ABOVE TREND, while small caps IWM (1W: -1.40% | 1M: -5.59%) BELOW TREND lag.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Reflation-biased: CPER (1W: +2.68% | 1M: +2.13%) ABOVE TREND and broad commodity ETFs showing 1M strength, while GLD (1W: +0.60% | 1M: -3.06%) RECOVERY — commodities up, gold taking profits.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy mixed: XLE (1W: -1.27% | 1M: +1.15%) CORRECTION and BNO (1W: -1.30% | 1M: +15.77%) CORRECTION alongside nat gas strength UNG (1W: +2.36% | 1M: +4.00%) ABOVE TREND.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: Tech leadership via XLK (1W: +1.03% | 1M: +3.25%) ABOVE TREND and QQQ (1W: +0.92% | 1M: +0.75%) ABOVE TREND. DIVERGENCE: Very narrow breadth (2/11) plus rising credit stress (HYG vs LQD) — minor duration divergence in TLT (1W: +0.47% | 1M: -1.76%) RECOVERY vs 1M negative.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor exposure to tech/momentum ETFs (XLK, QQQ) while reducing exposure to credit-sensitive and cyclical financials (Financials sector: 1W: -2.93% | 1M: -3.80%) BELOW TREND; monitor HYG/LQD and breadth for regime change.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: XLK (1W: +1.03% | 1M: +3.25%) ABOVE TREND; Healthcare (sector: 1W: +1.98% | 1M: -4.67%) showing relative strength. BEARISH: Financials (sector: 1W: -2.93% | 1M: -3.80%) BELOW TREND; Retail/XRT (1W: -3.26% | 1M: -7.66%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: CPER (1W: +2.68% | 1M: +2.13%) ABOVE TREND and UNG (1W: +2.36% | 1M: +4.00%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Oil wrappers USO (1W: -0.70% | 1M: +17.50%) CORRECTION and BNO (1W: -1.30% | 1M: +15.77%) CORRECTION—watch profit-taking.

13. Key Levels?
VXX 20 (VXX (1W: -1.72% | 1M: -6.77%) BELOW TREND) complacency marker; Credit spread ~0.75 (Credit Spread Level 0.7500) watch for widening; XLK/XLF ratio 3.3942 (Tech vs Financials 1W: +5.04% | 1M: +6.43%) ABOVE TREND as growth/value pivot.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive, VXX (1W: -1.72% | 1M: -6.77%) BELOW TREND and HYG/LQD (HYG (1W: -0.09% | 1M: -0.94%) BELOW TREND; LQD (1W: +0.36% | 1M: -1.34%) RECOVERY) divergence justify caution. Tech (XLK (1W: +1.03% | 1M: +3.25%) ABOVE TREND; QQQ (1W: +0.92% | 1M: +0.75%) ABOVE TREND) showing strength while credit and breadth are key risks to monitor.
